title: Fill flow step slots
description: Fills the empty `flow-*` slots of an emitted app, one at a time and each behind its own deterministic gate. Without an executor it reports what is pending and exits without touching anything

directory.description: Directory of the emitted app to fill (e.g. apps/solaris)

slot.description: Fill a single slot by id (e.g. flow-cie) instead of every pending one

bridge.description: Bridge directory where a watching Claude Code session answers the request; without it there is no executor
